<:block:1110959753800196247> Woodlin Elder has a questline that asks you to kill 50, 150 and 333 monsters exactly. Get it wrong, you have to start over. Completing all 3 quests rewards you with 8,000 gold food coupons.
<:block:1110959753800196247> I recommend using Dk as divine intervention and boomerang makes this quest quite simple.
<:block:1110959753800196247> You can also use orb to keep track however; it will include crystals in its count.

The map has 22 spawns split between 3 platforms.
* Platform one has 7 spawns.
* Platform two has 12 spawns.
* Platform three has 3 spawns.
* Platform four is where you need to stand to get quest credit, or to reset your progress should you mess up or lose count.
* Crystals do not count.
* These quests can be done consecutively and it will retain the kills from the previous to expedite the process. (Thank you <@323670898886574081>  for pointing this out <:Hearto:812252292597547018> )


**Consecutive**
Fiddy
> To kill 50 you need to fully clear the map twice and then kill all but one on the first platform.
Hunned Fiddy
> To get to 150 kills you need to fully clear the map 4 more times and then kill all 12 on platform 2.
Triple Tre
> To get to 333 kills you need to fully clear the map 8 more times and then kill all 7 on platform 1.

**Individual**
Fiddy
> To kill 50 you need to full clear the map twice and then kill all but one on the first platform.
Hunned Fiddy
> To kill 150 you need to fully clear the map 6 times, then kill the second platform and all but 1 on the first platform.
Triple Tre
> To kill 333 you need to fully clear the map 15 times, then kill the three on platform three.
